question: Where can I find the nearest stadium nearby Homewood Suites, Schaumburg, IL?
sql: SELECT P.poi_name, ST_Distance( P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Homewood Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Schaumburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) AS distance_meters FROM pois AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'stadium' OR P.amenity = 'stadium' ORDER BY P.geometry::geography <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Homewood Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Schaumburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ):geography LIMIT 1;
